question: Macaulay’s Minute on Education was passed in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1835**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On** 2 February 1835**, British historian and politician **Thomas Babington Macaulay** presented his ‘Minute on Indian Education,
 
• It sought to **establish** the **need to impart English education to Indian ‘natives’.**
 
• The famous Lord Macaulay’s Minute settled the** row in favour of Anglicists—** the limited government resources were to be devoted to the teaching of Western sciences a lone

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The British planned to **educate a small section of upper and middle classes**, thus creating a class **“Indian in blood and colour but English in tastes,** in opinions, in morals and in intellect”.
 
• Act interpreters between the government and masses and would enrich the vernaculars by which knowledge of** Western sciences and literature** would reach the masses. This was called the ‘**downward filtration theory.**
